mechanism: Eplerenone inhibits CYP3A4, which may increase warfarin levels; additionally, both drugs increase bleeding risk through anticoagulant and potassium-sparing mechanisms affecting hemostasis.
action: Monitor INR closely when initiating or adjusting eplerenone; assess bleeding risk and ensure adequate potassium monitoring as eplerenone increases hyperkalemia risk which can potentiate anticoagulant effects.
